name: OpenCode Config Manager
author: oliwier-xiao
description: Saved opencode model profiles in the bar. Switch which model every agent runs on with one click, and edit any profile from a searchable list of every model your opencode can reach.

barWidget.description: Switch between saved opencode model profiles and edit which model each agent uses.

schema.label: Next to the bar icon
schema.description: What the bar says about the profile in use. The name is the thing you chose it by and the thing you switch away from, so it is the default; the model is the thing you are paying for, and worth the width when the profiles differ only in that. Nothing leaves an icon, and the panel answers the question.

schema.label: After switching a profile
schema.description: A running opencode read its config when it started. Notify writes the files and says which sessions have not seen them yet. Restart opencode asks each running session to re-read its config where it stands — nothing closes and nothing is lost. A session fixes its model when it is created, so the conversation you are in keeps the one it started on; the switch lands on the next session and on the subagents every run after it spawns. Nothing writes the files and says nothing.

schema.label: Ask before switching
schema.description: A switch rewrites your opencode config, keeping a backup and an undo. Off is the fast path the bar is for; on is worth it when a mis-click would cost a long-running session.

schema.label: Manage opencode.json
schema.description: The default model and any agents defined there. Everything else in the file — providers, MCP servers, plugins, keybinds — is left exactly as it was.

schema.label: Manage oh-my-openagent.json
schema.description: The per-agent and per-category models that the oh-my-openagent plugin reads. Ignored when that file does not exist.

schema.label: Keep backups
schema.description: Copies of each config file taken immediately before a switch overwrites it, oldest deleted past this count. Undo reads the newest pair, which is never pruned, so one is always kept whatever this says.

schema.label: Refresh the model list every
schema.description: Hours. How often the models.dev catalogue behind the list — names, context windows, prices — is re-downloaded. What you can reach is a separate, local question, re-checked every few minutes on its own; opening the panel refreshes either in the background when it is due, and r forces both now.

schema.label: Show context and price
schema.description: Adds the context window and the per-million input and output price to every row in the model list, taken from models.dev. Off leaves the model names alone, which is the version to run on a narrow bar.

schema.label: opencode config folder
schema.description: Leave empty for the usual one. Set it to point at a second set of config files — the same thing OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR does for opencode itself.
